messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTIFICATION — embedding-store: ~0.5% of recent write batches produced duplicate vectors in us-east-1. Symptoms: intermittent incorrect search/recall for affected customers. We are treating as P2. Full context & runbook: https://internal.status.redwood/incident/1998654321 :rotating_light:

sanjay: Observed spike at 08:14 UTC. Root cause currently unknown, seen across embedding-ingest-v2 only. Ingest pipeline shows duplicate ack for some write shards.

maria: Rolling back recent indexing job (indexer-v2) now, ETA ~5m. Also toggled dedupe-check flag to ON for incoming writes.

jamal: Confirmed rollback kicked off. Indexer pods scaling down and will pick up prior checkpoint.

emily: Kicked off canary reingest with dedupe enabled for shard range [1000-1200] to validate. Will share logs.

maria: canary shows dedupe prevented duplicates in that range. No errors in reingest.

jamal: Quick mitigation steps applied: 1) rollback indexer-v2, 2) enable dedupe-check at write layer, 3) throttle parallel writes to 4x.

alex: Parity note — embeddings consumer read path is idempotent, but downstream search indexer assumed uniqueness which caused rank shifts.

cs-ops: Heads up — small set of customers (approx 12) reported noisy/duplicate results since ~08:10 UTC. CS drafting outbound note; will coordinate on support cases.

sanjay: Impact window estimated 08:10–08:22 UTC. Current status: partial mitigation in place, dedupe holding on canary. Overall error rate for embedding writes down to baseline.

emily: Metrics: write duplication rate: 0.5% -> 0.02% after mitigation (per telemetry). Search skew reduced for canary shards. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/embeddings/write-dedupe

maria: Next steps: 1) complete full rollout of dedupe-check across us-east-1 (30m), 2) run bounded reingest for affected customers if they opt in, 3) postmortem to be scheduled tomorrow (owners: eng-ml + eng-runtime).

jamal: Postmortem checklist: capture traces from write stream at 08:08–08:25, audit indexer-v2 commit sequence, review recent deploys to ingestion service.

cs-ops: Customer comms: short status update sent to affected accounts pointing to support ticket portal and workaround (reindex via console).

ops-bot: Current Status: partial mitigation. No active customer outages, degraded correctness for a subset of queries. Slack thread will be updated on major changes. Incident ticket: INC-1998654321.

sanjay: If anyone sees re-escalation or duplicate spikes, ping @sanjay and @maria immediately. Thanks all for quick response :heart:
